_meta.description: ADR-037 register fragment: Rechtmatigheidsverantwoording (BBV artikel 17a, verplicht sinds 2023). Declares the rechtmatigheidstoets / rechtmatigheidsbevinding / rechtmatigheidsparagraaf / tolerantiegrens schemas, additively extends JournalEntry (journaalpost) with the mandatory rechtmatigheid sub-object, and seeds the default tolerantiegrens per boekjaar (3% fout / 1% onzekerheid per BADO).

lawfulness.description: REQ-RV-001: mandatory rechtmatigheid sub-object tracking the legitimacy-assessment status of this journaalpost. Backward-compatible: existing journaalposten default to status niet_getoetst on first access. Embedded (not a separate register) to preserve the transaction-level audit-trail.

Rechtmatigheidstoets.title: Rechtmatigheidstoets
Rechtmatigheidstoets.description: REQ-RV-001 / REQ-RV-002: one automatic or manual assessment of one journaalpost against one of the nine wettelijke BBV-criteria. The atomic unit of rechtmatigheidsverantwoording (BBV artikel 17a). Wettelijke verplichting sinds 2023; gating functionaliteit voor jaarrekening-export.

onBudgetOvershoot._note: This rule has never fired. It carried a field=>value map ({criterium: begroting, kind: error}) — the SCHEDULED path's grammar — on a CREATED trigger. createdFilterMatches() reads a single clause {field, operator, value}, so it looked for a 'field' key, found none, and returned false for every bevinding. It cannot be repaired as-is either: the intent is criterium=begroting AND kind=error, and the created path has no combinator, only one clause. Narrowing to criterium=begroting alone would notify the portefeuillehouder about warnings and uncertainties as well as errors, which is a different rule than REQ-RV-001 asks for. Left disabled and honest rather than half-right, pending combinators on the created path — the created-vs-scheduled convergence deferred by ConductionNL/openregister#2787. DO NOT re-enable without a filter: with none, this matches every Rechtmatigheidsbevinding.
onBudgetOvershoot.description: REQ-RV-001: notify the portefeuillehouder of the affected programma when a begroting-fout bevinding is created.

Rechtmatigheidsparagraaf.title: Rechtmatigheidsparagraaf
Rechtmatigheidsparagraaf.description: REQ-RV-005 / REQ-RV-006: the aggregated jaarrekening statement per boekjaar. Compares totaal fouten/onzekerheden against toleranties, carries the college-verklaring, and transitions concept -> vastgesteld_college -> behandeld_raad -> definitief. Gating record for jaarrekening-export.

Tolerantiegrens.title: Tolerantiegrens

uncertainty_percentage.description: Maximum onzekerheid as a percentage of totaal lasten (default 1.0 per BADO).
